label: Spotlight
purpose: Photo-led viral news: colour photographs to the edge fading into ink, white type centred on the fade, a circular inset portrait on the cover and heavy quotes under a pair of quotation marks, with blueprint blue as the accent statement ground.

background.source: --text-primary in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, used here as the ground every photograph fades into and the ink of the shade: the ink the dark logotype is approved on.

surface.source: --surface-subtle in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, used here for the copy under a headline so the white headline stays the brightest thing on the slide.

surface-strong.source: --text-secondary in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, used here for the hairlines and thumbnail frames on the ink sources slide.

foreground.source: --surface-reading in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, used here as the type colour on the fade, on ink and on blue, and as the ring around the cover's inset.

muted.source: The one supporting colour, shared with the ticker look: a grey between --text-secondary and white for the sources slide's labels on ink, where #3c4149 reads at under 2:1. It clears 5.7:1 on #14161a.

accent.source: Blueprint blue: --accent-primary and the DNESK colour of the logotype; the accent statement's ground.

secondary.source: The Ai colour of the logotype (brandAi in lib/og-theme.ts); kept for the palette's seven tokens, unused by the kit's layers.

headline.source: A heavy grotesque at 800 for every headline and quote: wide and black enough to read as the viral-news display face at phone size, with drawn Czech accents.

body.source: A plain sans for the copy under a headline (400) and the uppercase attribution line (700), quieter than the display face.

mono.source: BRAND_SYSTEM.md: the sources slide's disclosure line, the only mono text in the kit.
